title: What Extended Car Warranties Don’t Cover: Common Exclusions Drivers Should Understand | Cuvrd
channel: Cuvrd | Extended Warranties & Auto Loan Refinancing
summary: A warranty-comparison platform's guide lists common exclusions -- maintenance, wear-and-tear, cosmetic damage, pre-existing conditions and modifications.

assertions.quote: vehicle service contracts often contain specific exclusions that limit what repairs are eligible for coverage
Providers typically require inspections or vehicle history checks to identify pre-existing issues before activating coverage
warranty providers may deny coverage for repairs related to those changes
most plans exclude damage such as: paint scratches, dents and body damage
